1: def toc(text):
2:     """
3:     Extract table of contents from markdown text.
4:     Returns a list of (level, title, slug) tuples, one per heading.
5:     The slug is the title in lower case with every run of characters that are not 
6:     letters or digits turned into one "-" and no "-" at either end.
7:     A slug seen before gets "-2", then "-3", and so on.
8:     """
9:     import re
10:     
11:     # Find all headings
12:     heading_pattern = r'^(#{1,6})\s+(.*?)$'
13:     
14:     headings = re.findall(heading_pattern, text, re.MULTILINE)
15:     
16:     slugs = {}
17:     result = []
18:     
19:     for level, title in headings:
20:         # Create base slug
21:         base_slug = re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9]+', '-', title.lower()).strip('-')
22:         
23:         # Handle duplicates
24:         slug = base_slug
25:         count = 1
26:         while slug in slugs:
27:             count += 1
28:             slug = f"{base_slug}-{count}"
29:         
30:         slugs[slug] = True
31:         result.append((len(level), title.strip(), slug))
32:     
33:     return result
